data.sourceWord: Q5.2: Justify the use of one data presentation technique, for example a graph or a map, in your human geography enquiry. (3 marks)
data.targetWord: or a map, in your human geography enquiry. Answer must relate to the human geography enquiry. Max 1 mark if reference to physical geography investigation. Answers will be ependent upon the type of investigation being undertaken. Credit can only be given to one presentation technique. 1 mark for stating the presentation technique and what it shows/how its is used eg Bar chart of house prices, radar graph of EQI scores/used to compare areas, land use map of the city centre. Mark not awarded for simply stating technique on its own eg line graph, bar chart. Presentation technique can be secondary ata-either their own work or provided by the teacher. Credit recording sheet for collecting field ata if clearly used as presentation method. 1-2 marks for saying why it was used/how it was useful, or eveloped points. These marks are still available if the 1st mark is not awarded. Examples can include | Useful for putting ata on | To show the location of the enquiry | Useful for comparing ifferent sites | Useful for interpretation/easy to read | Gives a good visual appreciation of the landscape
